explication: SMS Gateway for Android turns a phone into an SMS/MMS gateway. API clients submit messages through the local server or configured cloud/private gateway; messages are queued, optionally encrypted, and sent through Android telephony. Incoming SMS, data SMS, and MMS are captured, persisted, exposed through the API, and emitted as webhook events. The orchestrator starts these services, while the UI manages messages, settings, logs, and webhook queues. Some route and worker wiring is inferred from sampled service boundaries and the README.
